Applied automatically by cargo-llvm-cov in addition to the pattern above. Unit tests therefore live in sibling tests.rs files rather than in inline #[cfg(test)] modules, because a filename pattern cannot exclude test code embedded in a production file.

notes: Measured with --all-features so feature-gated modules (component_wasmtime, component_web) are included. The net line/function coverage ratio moved down slightly again (78.86% -> 78.81% lines, 78.42% -> 78.37% functions) as a real, deliberate, reviewed consequence, not an unnoticed regression -- both figures are taken directly from the CI quality/coverage job's own ubuntu-latest run (github.com/astorise/Magnetar/actions/runs/34695287896), matching this file's own established measurement methodology (CI-measured, not local, to avoid a platform-dependent false failure -- see the prior notes below).
